character: A remote resort in far northern Vermont, a few miles from the Canadian border, known for high natural snowfall and extensive glades. It has an aerial tram, slopeside hotels and an indoor waterpark.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the base areas. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Nov 22, 2026 (a third-party projection, not an announcement). Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.
